front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《34》

en: This is an afternoon of chrysanthemums and wine
Chrysanthemums, gathered from Tao Yuanming's eastern hedge
Wine, its color like the dawn light over the Aegean Sea
Lao Tzu's water: utmost softness
Beneath a thousand ages
Moistening all things, fine and silent

points.zh:
老子《 道德經 》78章:  「天下莫柔弱于水，而攻堅強者莫之能勝，以其無以易元。弱之勝強，柔之勝剛、天下莫不知，莫能行。」
「 好雨知時節，當春乃發生。隨風潛入夜，潤物細無聲。
野徑雲俱黑，江船火燭明。曉看紅濕處，花重錦官城。」
--唐。 杜甫《春夜喜雨》
points.en:
Laozi, Tao Te Ching, Chapter 78: "Nothing in the world is softer or weaker than water, yet in attacking the hard and strong, nothing surpasses it, for nothing can replace it. The weak overcomes the strong, the soft overcomes the hard — everyone under heaven knows this, yet none can put it into practice."
"A good rain knows its season, arriving with the spring.
It follows the wind, slipping in by night, moistening all things silently, without a sound.
On the wild paths, the clouds are all black; on the river boat, a lone lantern burns bright.
At dawn, look at the moist red patches — flowers heavy with rain in the Brocade City."
-- Tang Dynasty. Du Fu, "Happy Rain on a Spring Night"

en: Confucius's water: flowing forever on
Beneath a thousand ages
Hoist the cloud-sail straight and cross the vast blue sea

points.zh:
《 論語。子罕 》:  子在川上曰 :「 逝者如斯夫，不捨畫夜。」
金樽清酒斗十千，玉盤珍羞直萬錢。
停杯投箸不能食，拔劍四顧心茫然。
欲渡黃河冰塞川，將登太行雪滿山。
閑來垂釣碧溪上，忽復乘舟夢日邊。
行路難，行路難 !  多歧路，今安在 ﹖
長風破浪會有時，直掛雲帆濟滄海。
--唐。李白《行路難，三首其一》
points.en:
"Analects, Book IX (Zihan)": Confucius, standing by a river, said, "What passes on is like this, never ceasing day or night."
Fine wine in a golden cup, ten thousand coins a gallon; rare delicacies on jade plates, worth ten thousand cash.
Yet I set down my cup and chopsticks, unable to eat; I draw my sword and look about me, my heart lost and adrift.
I would cross the Yellow River, but ice blocks the stream; I would climb Mount Taihang, but snow covers the peaks.
At leisure I cast my fishing line by the green stream; then suddenly I dream of sailing a boat close to the sun.
The road is hard, the road is hard! So many forks -- where is the way now?
A time will come to ride the wind and break the waves; then I will hoist my cloud-white sail and cross the vast blue sea.
-- Tang dynasty, Li Bai, "The Road Is Hard," first of three poems

en: Walking to where the water ends
Looking back, the road I came by
Flying rain, falling blossoms, drifting fog
Deep in the night, who is there
Between turning pages, reading
The wind and rain outside the window
No one on the street
Besides the fine rain, besides the streetlamps
Dusk over Madrid
Beneath the pine I asked the boy
The last cicada song of summer
Drifting toward where?

points.zh:
松下問童子， 言師採藥去。 
只在此山中， 雲深不知處？
--唐 。賈島《尋隱者不遇》
points.en:
Beneath the pines I asked the boy;
he said, his master had gone to gather herbs.
He is only somewhere on this mountain,
but the clouds are deep, and I know not where?
-- Tang dynasty. Jia Dao, 'Seeking the Hermit but Not Finding Him'

en: Within the fragrance of coffee
Picking up again from a thousand miles away
The mood for looking at mountains
Friendship among gentlemen, light as
A trace of late-spring rain and mist
Now and then an egret flies out

points.zh:
薩爾瓦多．達利（Salvador Dali, 1904－1989），是20世紀超現實主義畫派的巨匠，也是西班牙著名印象派、主體派、達達主義畫家和古怪的抽象藝術的創始者。達利是一位精通物理、化學、數學、哲學、美學、科學的全才藝術家。很少有藝術家能像他那麼直截了當地碰觸那麼多複雜而多元的議題，是世界藝術史評家所認定繼達文西之後的「全才天才大師」，被國際公認最「超現實」的西班牙藝術家。在長達六十年的創作生涯中，產出了無數令人驚艷，叫人目瞪口呆的作品，而當中一件為人熟悉，而且不斷被藝術家置疑，引發靈感的作品，就是1931年創作的「永恆的記憶」 ( The Persistence of Memory ) ， 又名「柔軟的錶」 ( The Soft Watches ) ，關於作品蘊含的意義，藝評家們為此爭論不休，所提出的意見也是五花八門；雖然達利曾就這幅畫的由來做了一些說明，也沒能幫助觀者解開畫中謎題。但不論原來的涵義為何，或許根本沒有意義，此幅既強烈又撼動人心的畫，被視為超現實經典之作應不為過。
「在凝固的時間裡，記憶是恆久的。在柔軟的時間裡，藝術昇華，超越了可見的局限。」
points.en:
Salvador Dalí (1904–1989) was a towering master of 20th-century Surrealism, and Spain's celebrated pioneer of Impressionism, Cubism, Dadaism, and eccentric abstract art. Dalí was a supremely versatile artist, well-versed in physics, chemistry, mathematics, philosophy, aesthetics, and science. Few artists have engaged so directly with such a wide and complex range of subjects; historians of world art consider him the "all-round genius" after Leonardo da Vinci, and he is internationally recognized as the most "surreal" of Spanish artists. Over a creative career spanning sixty years, he produced countless astonishing, jaw-dropping works, among which one of the most familiar — and one that Dalí himself continually questioned and drew inspiration from — is his 1931 work "The Persistence of Memory," also known as "The Soft Watches." Critics have endlessly debated the meaning embedded in the work, offering a wide range of interpretations; although Dalí himself gave some explanation of the painting's origins, this has not helped viewers unlock the puzzle within it. But whatever its original meaning — or perhaps it has none at all — this powerful and deeply moving painting can rightly be regarded as a classic of Surrealism.
"In frozen time, memory endures. In soft time, art transcends, surpassing the limits of the visible."

points.zh:
Turn! Turn! Turn!   (To Everything There Is a Season)
Song written by Pete Seeger, 1950s
To everything   (turn, turn, turn)
There is a season  (turn, turn, turn)
And a time to every purpose, under heaven
A time to be born, a time to die
A time to plant, a time to reap
A time to kill, a time to heal
A time to laugh, a time to weep
A time to build up, a time to break down
A time to dance, a time to mourn
A time to cast away stones, a time to gather stones together
A time of love, a time of hate
A time of war, a time of peace
A time…
( 歌詞是舊約聖經  傳道書第三章1 ~ 8節 )
